mapper.insert: INSERT INTO teacher_student_binding ( teacher_id, teacher_name, student_id, student_name, college_name, course_code, course_name, course_class_code, academic_year, semester, source_type, sync_time ) VALUES ( #{teacherId}, #{teacherName}, #{studentId}, #{studentName}, #{collegeName}, #{courseCode}, #{courseName}, #{courseClassCode}, COALESCE(#{academicYear}, ''), COALESCE(#{semester}, ''), #{sourceType}, #{syncTime} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE teacher_name = CASE WHEN #{teacherName} IS NOT NULL AND #{teacherName} != '' AND #{teacherName} NOT REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' THEN #{teacherName} ELSE teacher_name END, student_name = CASE WHEN #{studentName} IS NOT NULL AND #{studentName} != '' AND #{studentName} NOT REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' THEN #{studentName} ELSE student_name END, college_name = COALESCE(#{collegeName}, college_name), course_name = COALESCE(#{courseName}, course_name), course_class_code = COALESCE(#{courseClassCode}, course_class_code), source_type = #{sourceType}, sync_time = #{syncTime}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT college_name FROM teacher_student_binding WHERE college_name IS NOT NULL AND college_name != '' ORDER BY college_name

SELECT b.id, b.teacher_id, b.student_id, b.college_name, b.course_code, b.course_name, b.course_class_code, b.academic_year, b.semester, b.source_type, b.sync_time, b.created_at, b.updated_at, COALESCE( NULLIF(b.teacher_name, ''), st.teacher_name ) AS teacher_name, CASE WHEN b.student_name IS NOT NULL AND b.student_name != '' AND b.student_name NOT REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' THEN b.student_name WHEN ss.student_name IS NOT NULL AND ss.student_name != '' AND ss.student_name NOT REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' THEN ss.student_name ELSE NULL END AS student_name FROM teacher_student_binding b LEFT JOIN school_teacher st ON st.teacher_id = b.teacher_id LEFT JOIN school_student ss ON ss.student_id = b.student_id ${ew.customSqlSegment}
